findings.title: Website name bypasses the untrusted-user-field restriction
findings.body: `website_name` is added to the serialized attributes but is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. For an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user, the serializer therefore hides `website` while still calling `website_name`, which derives and returns the website host (and sometimes its path). This leaks a value from a field the serializer explicitly restricts; add `website_name` to the same restriction and cover it in the anonymous-TL0 spec.
